truth.what_the_generator_does: Multiplies every dot's radius by an independent uniform(0.55, 1.5) draw. No dependence on dispense order, board position or neighbouring dots; shape is unchanged.
truth.what_it_does_not_encode: A cause. The image fixes the symptom, not why it happened, so no single cause can be proven from this case's inputs alone.

image_facts.fact: Sizes scatter in both directions: 3 oversized and 4 undersized out of 15 dots; none missing.
Deposit size spread across the array is 48.6% of the mean.
No dispense-order pattern: 1 of 4 small dots is followed by an oversized dot, and random placement gives at least that 62% of the time.
Shape is normal: mean circularity 0.896, above the 0.80 threshold for tailing or irregular dots.

Row 2 averages smaller (mean area ratio 0.69, against 1.03 and 1.38). Shuffling the same 15 sizes across positions gives a row gap at least this large 7.7% of the time (column gap: 72.8%), and the generator places sizes at random. This is not evidence of a positional cause.

reasons.volume_too_small_carryover: Its documented signature -- a small or missing dot followed by an over-sized dot (M12) -- is absent: 1 of 4, at chance level.
reasons.dispense_height_or_board_bending: Its documented signature -- deposit shape changing with board position (M06) -- is absent: circularity is normal and the row and column differences are within chance.
reasons.equipment_condition: The brief's own example ranks it last for inconsistent volume (B05), and nothing in this case points to it.

must_ask_before_final_ranking.why: The acceptable causes cannot be separated using this image. The brief separates air from the others by whether the change is occasional or continuous (B05).

should_ask.why: A new material lot or syringe bears on material condition and on air.

should_ask.text: Is the dispenser pressure-time or positive displacement (auger)?
should_ask.why: Pressure-time systems give variable volumes (M01, M10). The current pack has no question for this.

forbidden_claims: Small dots are followed by big dots (a carryover pattern) in this image.
Deposits are smeared, spread or irregular in shape.
A row, column or board position is worse, used as evidence for a cause.
A specific numeric parameter change (for example 'increase dispense time by 10-20%') that no cited passage states.
